newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco C.Bank injects 1.35 bln dirhams at auction.
newsitem.headline: Morocco C.Bank injects 1.35 bln dirhams at auction.

text.p: Morocco's Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) injected 1.35 billion dirhams in the money market for one week at its weekly repurchase auction, a bank official said on Friday.
The bank received bids totalling 7.664 billion dirhams and allocated 3.850 billion dirhams at 6.5 percent interest rate. It was more than the 2.500 billion dirhams leaving the market this week.
It satisfied 50.23 percent of demand for liquidity, the official said.
The next auction is scheduled for August 19.
